title: Walk & socialize intake dogs
condition: Directly confirmed with kennel coordinator today: afternoon walk slots are open for drop-in helpers who call ahead.

actionDetails.whatNeeded: Volunteers to walk, socialize, and give calm outdoor time to newly arrived intake dogs.
actionDetails.howToHelp: Call the front desk to confirm a 1-hour slot, then check in at the south kennel entrance. No prior shelter certification required for supervised walks.
actionDetails.bring: Closed-toe shoes, water bottle, photo ID

title: Direct-pay stray spay/neuter sponsorship
condition: Clinic desk confirmed direct phone payments can be applied to the active Stockton stray voucher ledger today.

actionDetails.howToHelp: Call the clinic front desk and request to apply a payment to the "Community Stray Voucher Fund". Ask for an emailed receipt.

title: Morning food box packing & kibble drop-off
condition: Receiving coordinator confirmed unopened dry dog food bags and morning packing helpers are welcome at the Sonora St gate.

actionDetails.howToHelp: Pull up to the Sonora St receiving gate and ask for the morning dock lead. Drop-offs take under 5 minutes.
